geraldoItems.description: Place this on the track and watch the first Bloons to touch it get shredded by the great whirling blades!
geraldoItems.levelText: New Item! Blade Trap - when a visible Bloon touches the trap, a Blade Maelstrom goes off. Geraldo's main attack increases in damage and pierce.
geraldoItems.name: Blade Trap

geraldoItems.description: 2.8 million Bloonville units. Whoever tastes this special sauce will be spewing fire for a while! *May have unforeseen benefits.
geraldoItems.levelText: New Item! Bottle of 'Gerry's Fire' - 2.8 million Bloonville units of pure hot sauce fire! Gives a Monkey, Hero, or minion a fiery attack for 5 rounds.
geraldoItems.name: Bottle of 'Gerry's Fire' Hot Sauce

geraldoItems.description: Place this spooky looking idol near the track to scare some Bloons back where they came from.
geraldoItems.levelText: Available Items! Shooty Turret, Stack of Old Nails, Creepy Idol, Jar of Pickles. Geraldo also has a short range magical attack.
geraldoItems.name: Creepy Idol

geraldoItems.description: Does that farm of yours have bananas? Want even more bananas? Sprinkle this extra-strength magical fertilizer directly on that farm and get more banana now!
geraldoItems.levelText: New Item! Fertilizer - targeted Banana Farms increase production and get a cash bonus over several rounds. Geraldo's main attack blast radius increases.
geraldoItems.name: Fertilizer

geraldoItems.description: Summon a Genie Monkey from this brilliant blue bottle but beware, it won't last forever! (no wishes included with purchase).
geraldoItems.levelText: New Item! Genie Bottle - summons a plasma-powered Genie Monkey that lasts for 2 rounds. Creepy Idol can now apply an occasional short stun to passing visible MOAB-class Bloons.
geraldoItems.name: Genie Bottle

geraldoItems.description: Try these pickles on one of your Monkey Towers and it will hit harder, but shoot slower for a while.
geraldoItems.levelText: Available Items! Shooty Turret, Stack of Old Nails, Creepy Idol, Jar of Pickles. Geraldo also has a short range magical attack.
geraldoItems.name: Jar of Pickles

geraldoItems.description: Boost your next Paragon's powers with this mystical artifact...
geraldoItems.levelText: New Item! Paragon Power Totem - adds paragon power to the next paragon created. Shop restocks fully! Geraldo's main attack does more damage.
geraldoItems.name: Paragon Power Totem

geraldoItems.description: Sometimes all you need is a super cute wee bunny pet! Or several!
geraldoItems.levelText: New Item! Pet Rabbit - aww what a cute widdle bunny wabbit!
geraldoItems.name: Pet Rabbit

geraldoItems.description: Limited edition, mint condition original Quincy, Son of Quincy action figure! This is only going to go up in value so buy it now!
geraldoItems.levelText: New Item! Rare Quincy Action Figure - increases in value the longer you possess it!
geraldoItems.name: Rare Quincy Action Figure

geraldoItems.description: Drop this delicious drink anywhere and watch its rejuvenating powers restore lost lives and reset ability cooldowns.
geraldoItems.levelText: New Item! Rejuv Potion - resets all Monkey Tower and Hero cooldowns, restores 50 lives. Geraldo's main attack pierce increases.
geraldoItems.name: Rejuv Potion

geraldoItems.description: Whatever Monkey you gift with this extremely efficacious elixir will be able to see Camo Bloons with ease! Effects will wear off.
geraldoItems.levelText: New Item! See Invisibility Potion - grants short term camo detection to a Monkey Tower or Hero. Geraldo's attack range increases.
geraldoItems.name: See Invisibility Potion

geraldoItems.description: Sharpen those darts, friend! Apply this to your darts and blades and they'll be sharper than ever before. Runs out after 10 rounds.
geraldoItems.levelText: New Item! Sharpening Stone - boosts the pierce of a Monkey Tower or Hero when doing sharp-type damage. Geraldo attacks faster.
geraldoItems.name: Sharpening Stone

geraldoItems.description: A permanent, hand-crafted dart shooting turret.
geraldoItems.levelText: Available Items! Shooty Turret, Stack of Old Nails, Creepy Idol, Jar of Pickles. Geraldo also has a short range magical attack.
geraldoItems.name: Shooty Turret

geraldoItems.description: Yes it's just a stack of old nails but put them anywhere on the track and they'll handily pop those stray Bloons.
geraldoItems.levelText: Available Items! Shooty Turret, Stack of Old Nails, Creepy Idol, Jar of Pickles. Geraldo also has a short range magical attack.
geraldoItems.name: Stack of Old Nails

geraldoItems.description: Truly amazing! Apply a tube of this modern marvel anywhere on the track and watch the next bunch of Bloons slow right down. Lasts 4 rounds or until used up.
geraldoItems.levelText: New Item! Tube of Amaz-o-Glue - can be placed on the track to slow Bloons down.
geraldoItems.name: Tube of Amaz-o-Glue

geraldoItems.description: All heroes wear capes! Give this to one of your Dart Monkeys and watch the transformation! Slightly used condition, only minor tiers, er, I mean tears.
geraldoItems.levelText: New Item! Worn Hero's Cape - converts a Tier 2 or lower Dart Monkey into a Super Monkey! These converted Super Monkeys can only be upgraded to Tier 3.
geraldoItems.name: Worn Hero's Cape

formula.damage: base x (1 + (degree-1) x damagePercentPerDegree/100) + floor((degree-1)/damageIncreaseForDegrees) x damageIncreasePerDegree
formula.note: power/cooldown/damage/pierce/boss formulas are reconstructed from the parameter names and match Bloons Wiki (https://www.bloonswiki.com/Paragon) values at degrees 10/20/100; the game code itself is not in the export
formula.pierce: base x (1 + (degree-1) x piercePercentPerDegree/100) + (degree-1) x pierceIncreasePerDegree
formula.power: min(maxPowerFromMoneySpent, cashSpentOnSacrifices / (paragonCost / moneySpentOverX); slider cash x (1 + paidContributionPenalty)) + min(maxPowerFromTier5Count, extraTier5s x tier5TowersMultByX) + min(maxPowerFromNonTier5Count, nonT5UpgradeTiers x nonTier5TowersMultByX) + min(maxPowerFromPops, damage / popsOverX + cashGenerated x cashEarnedContributionModifier / popsOverX) + totems x totemBonus
